displayIdentity.body: The Holy Spirit sends Paul and Barnabas. A false prophet opposes them before a governor. Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, names deceit and announces blindness. The governor sees what happens, believes, and marvels at the Lord’s teaching.
displayIdentity.title: Paul calls Elymas a son of the devil before the governor believes
